$comment: Cloudflare estate inventory. Read by scripts/autonomy/estate-drift.mjs (weekly, read-only). Every live Worker must either have a wrangler config in this repo (matched by name) or be listed under off_repo_workers with a disposition. Snapshot taken 2026-09-26 from the Cloudflare API: 66 Workers, 7 D1 databases, 20 KV namespaces, 10 R2 buckets. Counts here are a snapshot for humans; the drift job always reads the live list.

dispositions.archive: Source recovered into docs/archive/cf-workers/. Goal: move to workers/<name> with a wrangler config that matches the live name.
dispositions.retire: Superseded. Owner confirms nothing routes to it, then deletes it in the Cloudflare dashboard (deleting is an owner action).
dispositions.unrelated: Not an AuthiChain surface. Keep off AuthiChain docs; ignore in drift.
dispositions.unknown: Source not found anywhere. Owner decides: snapshot or retire.

qron-stripe-webhook.note: Named in SECURITY-REMEDIATION-CRITICAL.md (pending rotation). Retire after the Stripe keys it used are rolled.
